description: This file defines the 'Topic' class within the Opencart\\Catalog\\Model\\Cms namespace. The class extends a base Model class and contains methods to retrieve individual topics by ID and to list multiple topics, including caching mechanisms. It interacts with the database to fetch topic data and is part of the CMS module in the OpenCart catalog system.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Represents the Topic model in the CMS module, responsible for fetching topic data from the database, with support for caching.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Fetches a single topic by its ID, utilizing cache if available; if not, queries the database and caches the result.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active topics, with caching support, ordering by sort_order.
